question_types: recent trend of a market, index or asset class

evidence_requirements.description: Anchor to research_clock: the last completed session is the latest valid data date.
evidence_requirements.fallback: State the as-of date you assumed.

evidence_requirements.description: Daily price series for the index or a tradable proxy with a stated lookback (recent days plus longer context).
evidence_requirements.fallback: Use dated figures from news or filings, label them NOT market data, and say the market-data key is needed for the series.

evidence_requirements.description: Period returns, high-to-date drawdown and volatility computed deterministically.
evidence_requirements.fallback: State figures as approximate and unaudited.

evidence_requirements.description: Comparison with a broader benchmark and a breadth or constituent view.
evidence_requirements.fallback: State that breadth was not assessed.

evidence_requirements.description: Dated macro and news drivers: releases, policy, earnings of heavy constituents.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: each driver has a date and source
evidence_requirements.fallback: State that drivers are unverified leads.

look_for: evidence the trend is not a trend (range, mean reversion)
drivers that point the other way
measures that disagree (breadth vs index level)
counter_evidence.if_none_found: State what was searched and that no contrary evidence was found.

unit_and_period_checks: index level vs price return vs total return
window start and end dates and trading calendar

reconciliation.note: report differences and prefer market data

stopping_conditions: series, calculations and dated drivers collected
a data source is missing: report the gap and stop

must_state: that scenarios are inference with event and time-horizon definitions

limits: scenarios are inference, not forecasts; define each event and horizon; probabilities optional and, if given, state basis (subjective, historical base rate or calibrated) and keep joint and conditional values consistent; normalize only for mutually exclusive, exhaustive branches
market_data needs the user's own key
no intraday or constituent weights without a source
